items.title: 12.9 Kaainat mein matter aur antimatter ki adam-tanasub (asymmetry) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Bohat se mushahidat dikhate hain ke matter aur antimatter mein adam-tanasub hai; yeh hamari kaainat ki sab se numayan khusoosiyat mein se hai. Kai mushahidat batate hain ke kaainat taqreeban poori matter se bani hai, antimatter se nahi. Maslan kitab kaainat ko taqreeban 5% aam maadde (electrons, protons aur neutrons) wala batati hai, jis maadde mein taqreeban 72% hydrogen aur 24% helium hai, aur kaainat ki banawat mein antihydrogen ya antihelium atoms ka koi hissa nahi.

Kitab kehti hai ke matter aur antimatter ki adam-tanasub baryon number ki baqa ki khilaf-warzi ki wajah se hai, yaani baryons aur antibaryons ki tadaad mein adam-tawazun. Agar zarra-antizarra tanasub bhi toote to aisa nizam hoga jo antiquarks se zyada quarks, antileptons se zyada leptons, aur aakhir antimatter se zyada matter banaye. Lihaza nateeja nikala jata hai ke matter aur antimatter ki adam-tanasub abhi tak ek muamma (mystery) hai.

blocks.title: Ek hal-talab masla
blocks.text: Kaainat mein taqreeban koi antimatter kyun nahi, yeh physics ke bare jawab-talab sawalon mein se hai; upar ki wazahatein mafroozat (hypotheses) hain, sabit shuda nataij nahi.

blocks.prompt: Wajahein bataiye ke hamari kaainat taqreeban poori matter se kyun bani hai (comprehensive question 12.3). Matter aur antimatter ki adam-tanasub kin zarron ki tadaad ke adam-tawazun se hai (MCQ 12.16)?
blocks.explanation: Agar Big Bang ke baad matter aur antimatter bilkul barabar bante to aapas mein fana ho kar radiation ban jate; jo matter hum dekhte hain woh batata hai ke matter ki nanhi si zyadati bach gayi. Tajweez shuda wajahein aise amal hain jo baryon number baqi nahi rakhte aur zarron aur antizarron se thora mukhtalif sulook karte hain, ta ke antiquarks se zyada quarks aur antileptons se zyada leptons banein; asal wajah abhi tak muamma hai. MCQ 12.16: (c), baryons.

items: Kaainat taqreeban poori matter hai: koi antihydrogen ya antihelium nahi milta (kitab: aam maadda taqreeban 5%, us mein taqreeban 72% hydrogen aur 24% helium). Mashkook wajah: baryon number ki baqa aur zarra-antizarra tanasub ki khilaf-warzi; abhi tak hal-talab muamma.
